# DFAW Message Fixer
### "death.fell.accident.water" Message Fixer
Fixing [MC-195467](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC/issues/MC-195467) "Missing death message 'death.fell.accident.water' and its localization"

"death.fell.accident.water" is a death message, when you die because taking fall damage while you're in water (which seems impossible, but in some cases it's possible), see this video:

(Video are coming out soon)

✅ Tested and compatible with Minecraft 1.16.2 ~ 1.21.8

**⚠ You may see a version warning, but it’s safe to use in all supported versions.**

| en_pt            | Pirate Speak (The Seven Seas)              | Pirate English             |
| en_ud            | ɥsᴉꞁᵷuƎ (uʍoᗡ ǝpᴉsd∩)              | Upside down British English             |
| en_us            | English (US)              | American English             |
| enp            | Anglish (Oned Riches)              | Modern English minus borrowed words             |
